title: Use Seedance 2’s Wrestle preset in Higgsfield by uploading an image and…
content: Use Seedance 2’s Wrestle preset in Higgsfield by uploading an image and launching the preset to generate an ultra-stylish, dynamic video without needing a complex prompt.
tips: Use Seedance 2’s Wrestle preset in Higgsfield by uploading an image and launching the preset to generate an ultra-stylish, dynamic video without needing a complex prompt.

es.content: Usa el preset Wrestle de Seedance 2 en Higgsfield subiendo una imagen y lanzando el preset para generar un video ultra-estilizado y dinámico sin necesidad de un prompt complejo.

fr.content: Utilisez le préréglage Wrestle de Seedance 2 dans Higgsfield en téléchargeant une image et en lançant le préréglage pour générer une vidéo ultra-stylée et dynamique sans avoir besoin d'un prompt complexe.

ja.content:
---
Higgsfieldで画像をアップロードし、Seedance 2のWrestleプリセットを起動することで、複雑なプロンプトを必要とせずに、超スタイリッシュでダイナミックなビデオを生成できます。

ko.content: Higgsfield에서 Seedance 2의 Wrestle 프리셋을 사용하여 이미지를 업로드하고 프리셋을 실행하면 복잡한 프롬프트 없이도 초스타일리시하고 다이내믹한 비디오를 생성할 수 있습니다.

pt.content: Use o preset Wrestle do Seedance 2 no Higgsfield carregando uma imagem e lançando o preset para gerar um vídeo ultra-estiloso e dinâmico sem precisar de um prompt complexo.

zh.content: 在Higgsfield中使用Seedance 2的Wrestle预设，通过上传图像并启动预设，无需复杂的prompt即可生成超时尚、动态的视频。
